surface.purpose: runtime-presence, concise feature ledger, and binary presentation/accessibility preferences only
surface.notes: A RealPass version keeps one authored physical simulation. The public surface may describe active authorities and toggle presentation channels, but never rebalance or disable the underlying simulation.

developmentFeedbackFallback.rule: Do not remove a useful native indicator before the corresponding RealPass Biology/HUD/gameplay feedback has passed attended acceptance. This is a development transition rule, not the final presentation target.

publicControls.description: Controls only fullscreen/audio disorientation feedback for excessive analgesic load; hidden pain, dose, injury, weapon handling, bleeding and recovery remain unchanged.

developmentRules: Development profile keys exist only to isolate authorities during compilation, calibration and attended diagnosis.
A release builder fixes gameplay/presentation authority keys to the release profile and diagnostics off.
Development authority gates are never persisted as normal player preferences.
A public presentation preference may suppress a cue only when the underlying physical simulation and consequences continue unchanged.
binaryPreferenceRule: A public boolean is allowed only when changing it cannot change physical state, rates, damage, protection, injury, pain state, treatment, recovery or other simulation authority.
